# `modernize-array-list-access`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: modernize · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports deprecated `getLastOrNull()` and `getLast()` calls on proven standard
`ArrayList` / `array_list.Aligned` values.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Zig 0.17 consolidates the last-element API around the optional `last()` method.
`getLast` remains as a deprecated compatibility method.

## When it fires

Fixes use `last()` and `last().?`, respectively, preserving the optional result
or nonempty requirement.

Receiver proof follows explicit types, known list initializers, namespace
aliases and scoped type/value aliases rooted in `@import("std")`. Legacy
unmanaged and aligned type aliases are recognized. Custom methods, unknown
receivers, mutable namespace/type aliases and shadowed aliases are skipped.
Mutable list values retain their known type. Zero-argument calls receive safe
quick fixes; other call shapes receive advice only. Comments inside
zero-argument calls are preserved.

```zig
// Before
const optional = list.getLastOrNull();
const required = list.getLast();

// After
const optional = list.last();
const required = list.last().?;
```

See the [Zig 0.17 ArrayList
changes](https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/release-notes.html#ArrayList).

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn last(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) !?u8 {
    var list: std.ArrayList(u8) = .empty;
    defer list.deinit(gpa);
    try list.append(gpa, 1);
    return list.getLastOrNull();
}
```
